cause.en: The Claude Code sign-in has expired.
cause.zh: Claude Code 的登录已经过期。

fix.en: Open Claude Code once so it renews the sign-in.
fix.zh: 打开一次 Claude Code，让它自动续期。

title.zh: 这个登录不能用于共享

cause.en: This Claude Code sign-in lacks a permission sharing needs.
cause.zh: 这个 Claude Code 登录缺少共享所需的权限。

fix.en: Run claude and sign in again with your subscription account.
fix.zh: 运行 claude，用订阅账号重新登录。

title.zh: 没有检测到 Claude Code 登录

cause.en: Bee cannot read a Claude Code sign-in on this computer.
cause.zh: Bee 在这台电脑上读取不到 Claude Code 的登录。

fix.en: Install Claude Code, open a terminal, run claude and sign in to your subscription, then check again. On a Mac, allow Bee when macOS asks about the keychain.
fix.zh: 安装 Claude Code，打开终端运行 claude 登录你的订阅账号，然后重新检测。Mac 上系统询问钥匙串权限时，请选择“始终允许”。

cause.en: Bee was told to read Claude Code's sign-in from a store this system does not have.
cause.zh: Bee 被设置为从一个这台电脑没有的位置读取 Claude Code 登录。

fix.en: Remove this account and add it again.
fix.zh: 删除这个账号后重新添加。

cause.en: The Codex sign-in has expired; TokHive renews it while Bee is connected.
cause.zh: Codex 登录已过期，Bee 连上 TokHive 后会自动续期。

fix.en: Keep Bee running. If it does not recover, run codex login again.
fix.zh: 请保持 Bee 运行；如果一直没恢复，请重新运行 codex login。

title.zh: 读取不到 Codex 登录

cause.en: Bee cannot use the Codex sign-in on this computer. It must be a ChatGPT sign-in, not an API key.
cause.zh: Bee 用不了这台电脑上的 Codex 登录。必须是 ChatGPT 账号登录，不能是 API Key。

fix.en: Open a terminal, run codex login and sign in with your ChatGPT account, then check again.
fix.zh: 打开终端运行 codex login，用 ChatGPT 账号登录，然后重新检测。

cause.en: Bee cannot use its saved link to TokHive.
cause.zh: Bee 无法使用保存的绑定信息。

fix.en: Export a diagnostic report and contact TokHive support. Do not delete Bee's files.
fix.zh: 请导出诊断报告并联系 TokHive 客服，不要删除 Bee 的文件。

title.zh: 账号已绑定到另一台电脑

cause.en: Your TokHive account was linked to another computer, so this one stopped.
cause.zh: 你的 TokHive 账号绑定了另一台电脑，所以这台已停止。

fix.en: Link this computer again if you want it to share instead.
fix.zh: 如果想改用这台电脑共享，请重新绑定。

cause.en: TokHive no longer accepts this computer's link.
cause.zh: TokHive 不再接受这台电脑的绑定。

fix.en: Link this computer to your TokHive account again.
fix.zh: 请重新绑定这台电脑。

cause.en: TokHive answered with an unexpected error.
cause.zh: TokHive 返回了意外的错误。

fix.en: Try again later. If it keeps happening, export a diagnostic report and contact TokHive support.
fix.zh: 请稍后重试；如果一直出现，请导出诊断报告并联系 TokHive 客服。

cause.en: Bee cannot connect to TokHive. The network may be down, or TokHive may be briefly unavailable.
cause.zh: Bee 连不上 TokHive，可能是网络断了，也可能是 TokHive 暂时不可用。

fix.en: Check the network. If you use a proxy, set it in Settings. Bee keeps retrying.
fix.zh: 请检查网络；如果需要代理，请在设置里填写。Bee 会自动重试。

title.zh: 没有检测到 Codex 登录

cause.en: Bee found no Codex sign-in on this computer.
cause.zh: Bee 在这台电脑上没有找到 Codex 的登录。

fix.en: Install Codex, open a terminal, run codex login and sign in to your ChatGPT subscription, then check again.
fix.zh: 安装 Codex，打开终端运行 codex login 登录你的 ChatGPT 订阅账号，然后重新检测。

cause.en: TokHive only accepts certain accounts on this platform, and this one is not among them.
cause.zh: TokHive 在这个平台只接受部分账号，这个账号不在其中。

fix.en: Contact TokHive support and give them the account number.
fix.zh: 请联系 TokHive 客服，并提供账号编号。

cause.en: Bee has not registered this account with TokHive yet.
cause.zh: Bee 还没把这个账号登记到 TokHive。

fix.en: Keep Bee running; it usually takes a few minutes.
fix.zh: 请保持 Bee 运行，通常需要几分钟。

cause.en: TokHive has not received a usable authorization from this computer yet.
cause.zh: TokHive 还没收到这台电脑发来的可用授权。

fix.en: Keep Bee running; this usually clears within a few minutes. If it stays, sign in again in the official app.
fix.zh: 请保持 Bee 运行，通常几分钟内恢复；如果一直这样，请在官方客户端重新登录。

cause.en: TokHive has stopped sharing for this account.
cause.zh: TokHive 暂停了这个账号的共享。

fix.en: Contact TokHive support and give them the account number.
fix.zh: 请联系 TokHive 客服，并提供账号编号。

cause.en: Bee is reading this account's models and quota.
cause.zh: Bee 正在读取这个账号的模型和额度。

fix.en: Nothing to do. It usually takes 1 to 3 minutes.
fix.zh: 不用处理，通常需要 1 到 3 分钟。

cause.en: This Claude account is already shared from another TokHive account.
cause.zh: 这个 Claude 账号已被另一个 TokHive 账号使用。

fix.en: Use a different account, or ask the other person to release it in TokHive.
fix.zh: 你可以换用其他账号，或请对方在 TokHive 中释放它。

cause.en: Claude rejected this account's sign-in. It has usually expired.
cause.zh: Claude 拒绝了这个账号的授权，通常是登录已失效。

fix.en: Open a terminal, run claude and sign in to the same account again.
fix.zh: 打开终端运行 claude，重新登录同一个账号。

fix_import.en: Sign in again on the computer the file came from, export the credential file again and import it here.
fix_import.zh: 在导出文件的那台电脑上重新登录，重新导出凭证文件后，在这里重新导入。

cause.en: Claude Code is now signed in to a different account than the one being shared.
cause.zh: Claude Code 现在登录的账号和正在共享的不是同一个。

fix.en: Choose Use new account to share it, or remove this account.
fix.zh: 点“改用新账号”开始共享新账号，或者删除这个账号。

cause.en: Bee cannot read the Claude Code sign-in on this computer. You may have signed out.
cause.zh: Bee 读取不到这台电脑上 Claude Code 的登录，可能已经退出登录。

fix.en: Open a terminal, run claude and sign in to the same account. Bee picks it up by itself.
fix.zh: 打开终端运行 claude，重新登录同一个账号，Bee 会自动识别。

fix_import.en: Sign in again on the computer the file came from, export the credential file again and import it here.
fix_import.zh: 在导出文件的那台电脑上重新登录，重新导出凭证文件后，在这里重新导入。

cause.en: This ChatGPT account is already shared from another TokHive account.
cause.zh: 这个 ChatGPT 账号已被另一个 TokHive 账号使用。

fix.en: Use a different account, or ask the other person to release it in TokHive.
fix.zh: 你可以换用其他账号，或请对方在 TokHive 中释放它。

cause.en: ChatGPT rejected this account's sign-in. It has usually expired.
cause.zh: ChatGPT 拒绝了这个账号的授权，通常是登录已失效。

fix.en: Open a terminal, run codex login and sign in to the same account again.
fix.zh: 打开终端运行 codex login，重新登录同一个账号。

fix_import.en: Sign in again on the computer the file came from, export the credential file again and import it here.
fix_import.zh: 在导出文件的那台电脑上重新登录，重新导出凭证文件后，在这里重新导入。

cause.en: Codex is now signed in to a different account than the one being shared.
cause.zh: Codex 现在登录的账号和正在共享的不是同一个。

fix.en: Choose Use new account to share it, or remove this account.
fix.zh: 点“改用新账号”开始共享新账号，或者删除这个账号。

cause.en: Bee cannot read the Codex sign-in on this computer. You may have signed out.
cause.zh: Bee 读取不到这台电脑上 Codex 的登录，可能已经退出登录。

fix.en: Open a terminal, run codex login and sign in to the same account. Bee picks it up by itself.
fix.zh: 打开终端运行 codex login，重新登录同一个账号，Bee 会自动识别。

fix_import.en: Sign in again on the computer the file came from, export the credential file again and import it here.
fix_import.zh: 在导出文件的那台电脑上重新登录，重新导出凭证文件后，在这里重新导入。

cause.en: This account is already handling as many requests as its plan allows.
cause.zh: 这个账号正在处理的请求已经达到套餐允许的上限。

fix.en: Nothing to do. It takes new work as current requests finish.
fix.zh: 不用处理，手头请求完成后就会接新的。

cause.en: TokHive did not confirm the switch.
cause.zh: TokHive 没有确认换号。

fix.en: Check the network and try again.
fix.zh: 请检查网络后重试。

cause.en: Your TokHive account is being moved to another computer. This one finishes the requests it has and then stops.
cause.zh: 你的 TokHive 账号正在换绑到另一台电脑，这台电脑处理完手头的请求后就会停止。

fix.en: Nothing to do here. The other computer takes over automatically.
fix.zh: 这里不用操作，另一台电脑会自动接手。

cause.en: Bee could not get an answer from TokHive.
cause.zh: Bee 没有收到 TokHive 的回应。

fix.en: Check the network and try again.
fix.zh: 请检查网络后重试。

cause.en: This sign-in has expired and cannot be renewed.
cause.zh: 这个登录已经过期，而且无法续期。

fix.en: Sign in again, then export the file again.
fix.zh: 请重新登录，然后重新导出文件。

cause.en: This file is not a usable sign-in for this platform. Codex uses auth.json; Claude Code uses .credentials.json.
cause.zh: 这个文件不是这个平台可用的登录。Codex 用的是 auth.json，Claude Code 用的是 .credentials.json。

fix.en: Choose the right file for this platform.
fix.zh: 请选择这个平台对应的文件。

title.zh: 这个登录不能用于共享

cause.en: This sign-in lacks a permission sharing needs.
cause.zh: 这个登录缺少共享所需的权限。

fix.en: Sign in again in Claude Code with your subscription account, then export the file again.
fix.zh: 在 Claude Code 中用订阅账号重新登录，然后重新导出文件。

cause.en: Bee cannot open the file you chose.
cause.zh: Bee 打不开你选择的文件。

fix.en: Check the file still exists and choose it again.
fix.zh: 请确认文件还在，然后重新选择。

title.zh: 这个登录不能用于共享

cause.en: This Claude Code sign-in lacks a permission sharing needs.
cause.zh: 这个 Claude Code 登录缺少共享所需的权限。

fix.en: Run claude and sign in again with your subscription account, then check again.
fix.zh: 运行 claude，用订阅账号重新登录，然后重新检测。

cause.en: You paused sharing, so this account takes no new requests.
cause.zh: 你暂停了共享，这个账号不会接新的请求。

fix.en: Choose Start sharing when you want it to take work again.
fix.zh: 想继续共享时，点“开始共享”。

cause.en: TokHive has no model on sale for this platform right now, so there is nothing for this account to serve.
cause.zh: TokHive 目前没有上架这个平台的模型，所以这个账号暂时没有可接的单。

fix.en: Nothing to do. Sharing starts by itself once TokHive puts a model on sale.
fix.zh: 不用处理，TokHive 上架模型后会自动开始共享。

cause.en: None of the models TokHive offers can run on this account's plan.
cause.zh: TokHive 提供的模型在这个账号的套餐下都用不了。

fix.en: Check the account's plan in the official app. If it should qualify, contact TokHive support.
fix.zh: 请在官方客户端确认账号的套餐；如果套餐应该支持，请联系 TokHive 客服。

cause.en: TokHive is not waiting for an account switch on this platform.
cause.zh: TokHive 目前没有在等这个平台的换号确认。

fix.en: Nothing to do.
fix.zh: 不用处理。

cause.en: TokHive has no account registered for this platform, or does not offer it.
cause.zh: TokHive 上没有这个平台的账号记录，或者暂不提供这个平台。

fix.en: If you just added the account, wait a few minutes. Otherwise contact TokHive support.
fix.zh: 如果刚添加账号，请等几分钟；否则请联系 TokHive 客服。

cause.en: This computer is not linked to a TokHive account.
cause.zh: 这台电脑还没有绑定 TokHive 账号。

fix.en: Link it to your TokHive account first.
fix.zh: 请先绑定 TokHive 账号。

cause.en: TokHive cannot reach this computer right now.
cause.zh: TokHive 现在连不上这台电脑。

fix.en: Keep Bee running and check this computer's network.
fix.zh: 请保持 Bee 运行，并检查这台电脑的网络。

cause.en: TokHive ended the linking before it was confirmed.
cause.zh: 绑定在确认前就被 TokHive 结束了。

fix.en: Start linking again.
fix.zh: 请重新开始绑定。

cause.en: TokHive ended the linking before it was confirmed.
cause.zh: 绑定在确认前就被 TokHive 结束了。

fix.en: Start linking again.
fix.zh: 请重新开始绑定。

cause.en: TokHive ended the linking before it was confirmed.
cause.zh: 绑定在确认前就被 TokHive 结束了。

fix.en: Start linking again.
fix.zh: 请重新开始绑定。

cause.en: TokHive did not confirm the pause, so nothing was changed.
cause.zh: TokHive 没有确认暂停，所以什么都没变。

fix.en: Check the network and try again.
fix.zh: 请检查网络后重试。

title.en: Plan not set up on TokHive
title.zh: TokHive 尚未支持这个套餐

cause.en: TokHive has not set up sharing for this account's plan yet.
cause.zh: TokHive 还没有为这个套餐配置共享。

fix.en: Contact TokHive support and give them the account number.
fix.zh: 请联系 TokHive 客服，并提供账号编号。

cause.en: This version shares one account per platform.
cause.zh: 当前版本每个平台支持一个账号。

fix.en: Remove the current account first.
fix.zh: 请先删除已有账号。

cause.en: This account has used all of its quota for the current window.
cause.zh: 这个账号当前时间窗口的额度已经用完。

fix.en: Nothing to do. Sharing resumes when the quota resets.
fix.zh: 不用处理，额度重置后会自动恢复共享。

cause.en: Bee could not read this account's quota yet and is trying again.
cause.zh: Bee 暂时没读到这个账号的额度，正在重试。

fix.en: Nothing to do. Keep Bee running.
fix.zh: 不用处理，请保持 Bee 运行。

cause.en: The platform is limiting how fast this account can be used.
cause.zh: 平台正在限制这个账号的使用频率。

fix.en: Nothing to do. Sharing resumes when the cooldown ends.
fix.zh: 不用处理，冷却结束后会自动恢复共享。

cause.en: TokHive has a different setup for your account on this platform, so this computer does not share it.
cause.zh: TokHive 为你的账号在这个平台上做了单独配置，所以这台电脑不共享它。

fix.en: Contact TokHive support.
fix.zh: 请联系 TokHive 客服。

cause.en: TokHive does not accept shared subscriptions for this platform yet.
cause.zh: TokHive 暂时不接受这个平台的订阅共享。

fix.en: Contact TokHive support if you think this is wrong.
fix.zh: 如有疑问，请联系 TokHive 客服。

cause.en: TokHive did not confirm the change, so sharing is as it was.
cause.zh: TokHive 没有确认这次操作，共享状态保持不变。

fix.en: Check the network and try again.
fix.zh: 请检查网络后重试。
